fusions.name: Margin Note
fusions.desc: Throws a slip that deals 7 damage and has a 50% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Fine Print
fusions.desc: Looses a wide cone that deals 28 damage to everything caught in it, ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Returned to Sender
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

fusions.name: Marginalia
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
